description: List invoices from AbaNinja. Filters: status ('offen' | 'bezahlt' | 'ueberfaellig' | 'alle'), from/to (invoice date, YYYY-MM-DD), customer (name or customer number, substring match), limit. Returns invoice number, date, customer, amount, currency, status and due date. Pagination is resolved server-side — the caller gets the complete result, not a page. Read-only. 'ueberfaellig' means open AND due date in the past, not merely the API's 'due' status, because a document can be overdue without anyone having updated its status.

customer.description: Substring of customer name or customer number.

name: list_abaninja_invoices
